title: Velo Client 1.4.1: Lyrics in the sky & the Video Player
summary: Synced lyrics floating in your world, a brand-new Video Player with YouTube, Shorts, Twitch and your own files, six new HUD modules, real Motion Blur, a much better 1.8.9 and lots of fixes.

blocks.text: **Velo Client 1.4.1** brings your music into the game: the lyrics of whatever you're listening to, right in the sky. Plus a completely new **Video Player**, new HUD modules, real **Motion Blur** and a big update for **1.8.9**.

blocks.caption: The Lyrics Studio: every setting on the left, the live preview in your world on the right.

items: The lyrics of the song playing on **Spotify** (or any player your PC's media controls know), **synced line by line**
**In the sky** - behind mountains and clouds like it's really up there - **floating in front of you**, or flat on screen
Lines can stay in one spot or appear **all around you**
**19 presets**: Concert Sky, Starfield, Aurora, Neon Night, Hologram, Karaoke, Comic, Fire, Frost, Vaporwave, Terminal, Ghost and more
Crazy customizing: 8 fonts, gradients, rainbow, karaoke fill, **glow**, outline, shadow, 15 ways to come in, 11 ways to go out, letter spacing, tilt, chaos
Lyrics early or late? One slider fixes the sync

blocks.caption: The Comic preset: words bounce in all around you.
Search, Shorts, Twitch and your own files in one window.

items: **YouTube**: search or paste any link - videos, shorts, live streams
**Shorts**: an endless feed in a tall window - scroll, arrow keys or your own **Next / Previous Short** keys, even while it plays as picture-in-picture
**Twitch**: paste a channel and its live stream starts; videos and clips work too
**Files**: play videos from your PC (MP4, MKV, WEBM, MOV...) - and links from many other sites
A new look with Velo fonts: controls only appear when you hover, drag to move, resize from any edge, fullscreen and picture-in-picture
Open it with **U** (changeable) - press it again to close

blocks.caption: Shorts in a tall window - the next one is already loaded.

items: **Mini Player**: a small live 3D you on the HUD with your skin, armour and cosmetics
**Inventory HUD**: see your inventory mid-fight
**Module List**: what you have turned on, right on screen
**Server Display**: the server's logo and IP - great for videos
**Custom Text** with live placeholders like {fps}, {ping}, {server}, and **Custom Image** for your own logo or banner
**Motion Blur**: real camera motion blur with strong settings (off by default)
**TNT Optimizer**: for TNT farms and cannons (off by default)
A real **Right Shift menu** with a HUD editor
The **Locker**: pick your Velo cloak right in 1.8.9
**Freelook**, **Hit Color**, **1.7 Animations** (block-hitting, red armour), Zoom, Toggle Sprint, Fullbright
FPS, CPS, Keystrokes, Coordinates, Ping, Armor and Potion Status, Clock, Reach Display, Dynamic FPS and an FPS Boost
**Color Grading** no longer turns the screen black
**Primed TNT** is visible again
**Anti Farm Lag** is now off for everyone - turn it on only if you want it
**Windows media controls** work now (play, pause, skip)
**Report a bug** can record 60 seconds of lag spikes and send what caused them
The launcher's Home shows **how many players are on Velo today**
Fixed crashes when changing worlds and when closing the game, and a launcher crash with long clips
Sodium and Iris always get matching versions
New on the website: a **Creators** page and **every module** listed on the features page
